text: dsh-approval-watch 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的待处理事项提醒插件。它将审批、计划确认和用户问题汇总成全局浮动面板，并从会话列表快照读取待处理状态。面板可拖动和折叠，显示事项数量、类型与会话标题；点击条目可打开对应会话继续处理。适合同时运行多个会话、希望及时发现需要人工响应事项的 DSH 用户。代码没有配置 API 密钥或外部服务调用。

dsh-approval-watch adds a floating reminder to the DSH web client. It lists sessions waiting for an approval, plan review, or user answer. The panel can be moved or collapsed, shows each item type and session title, and opens that session when clicked. No API key or external service is configured.
想在 DSH 网页里看到所有会话等待我处理的审批和问题
有没有办法点一下提醒就跳到需要确认的会话？
Show me a persistent web overlay when any DSH session needs an approval or answer.
dsh-approval-watch 的功能「跨会话待处理提醒」：在 DSH 网页浮层中汇总含有待处理审批、计划确认或用户问题的会话，显示事项类型、会话标题和数量。用户点击条目即可打开对应会话。

dsh-approval-watch README · dsh-approval-watch：Global approval / question reminder overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

When any session has a pending tool approval, a plan review, or a user question, a persistent floating overlay pops up at the bottom-right of the DSH web UI (draggable, collapsible). Clicking an entry jumps straight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are out of sight.

dsh-approval-watch README · How it works：- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behavior lives in the browser half (`lib/client.js`), which registers a shell overlay entry.
- The `dsh.client` manifest injects the browser half into the web client runtime.

dsh-approval-watch README · Install：Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
